propositions: Bridge fsck reported four unbound Jira issues (REB-806, REB-807, REB-808) with missing forward/reverse binding-store entries despite exact identity matches with existing local code_review artifacts.
Three Jira issues were verified to be exact identity matches to local artifacts by rebar-id label, title, revision, PASS decision, and fingerprint through ACLI inspection.
Binding repair was executed by confirming three exact artifact-to-Jira pairs via BindingStore.bind_confirm under unified write lock and persisting atomically through commit_and_push_tickets_branch.
Post-repair bridge fsck verification confirmed all six forward/reverse lookup mappings and reported zero alerting binding-drift and store-integrity findings.
No new local tickets or Jira issues were created, archived, or transitioned during remediation.
